items.prompt: The program calls to_cents<false>(7) and to_cents<true>(7). Which pair of returned integers and selection mechanism is correct?

options.text: (7,700), selected by a branch on the current input value.
options.why: The argument false denotes whole currency units and chooses multiplication by 100; the selection is fixed by type, not by x.

options.text: (700,7), selected by bool_constant tag types during compilation.
options.why: The false_type overload multiplies by 100; the true_type overload preserves cents. The template argument determines the overload.

options.text: (700,700), because both overloads share one function name.
options.why: Overload resolution distinguishes their tag parameter types; sharing a name does not collapse their behavior.

options.text: (7,7), because template arguments cannot affect runtime values.
options.why: Compile-time selection can choose different computations that produce different runtime values.
